newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates lightly quoted on call session.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates lightly quoted on call session.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were lightly quoted at the St. Louis Merchants Exchange on Friday. No barges traded versus none on Thursday.
- Two barges, Ohio (Jefferson-Cincinnati), next week, bid 115 percent of tariff, no offer or comparison.
- Two barges, Mississippi (St. Louis) week of January 26, offered at 135 percent, no bid or comparison.
- Two barges, lower Ohio for the week of January 26, bid at 110 percent, no offer or comparison.
- Two barges, Mississipi (St. Louis) one each week of January 19 and 26, offered at 140 percent, no bid or comparison.
- Eight barges, Ohio, two each week of February, offered at 130 percent, no bid or comparison.
- Four barges, Mississippi (St. Louis) one each week of February, offered at 120 percent of tariff, no bid or comparison.
- Four barges, Mississippi (Osceola through Cairo), one each week of February, offered at 107-1/2 percent, no bid or comparison.
